text: On a bus, Joy Ramirez finds a bagua mirror left behind by a passenger and, on a baker's advice, [hangs it at her front door|trigger|bringing something home] for luck. A promotion and a supermarket prize follow, and so do deaths, each shaped by the victim's Chinese zodiac sign, beginning with the passenger hit by a Rabbit Liner bus. Anyone who sees their reflection is [marked by their birth year|rules|it chooses who dies], for the mirror [takes a soul|wants|claiming souls and victims] for every stroke of good fortune. Its curse goes back to [a woman burned at the stake in Shanghai|origin|the wronged dead return].
